sections.A: McKenzie (MDT) mein baar baar movements aur positions se patients ko is baat par classify kiya jata hai ke symptoms kaise badalte hain.
sections.B: Classifications: derangement (symptoms aur range tezi se badlein, ek direction behtar), dysfunction aur postural.
sections.C: Pehle baseline (symptoms aur range), phir baar baar movements aur dekhein ke symptoms markaz ki taraf aate hain (centralisation) ya nahi.
sections.D: Extension preference mein prone lying, phir elbows par, phir press-ups; din mein kai dafa.
sections.E: Agar symptoms taang mein neeche phailein (peripheralisation) ya neuro signs barhein to ruk jayein.
sections.F: Sawaal hal karein. Centralisation: baar baar movement se referred symptoms reedh ki taraf aana.
sections.now-you-should-be-able-to: Yeh checklist hai. Har point khud kar sakein to tick karein.
